rows.Name: Ammarah
rows.Description: The base-desire-driven state. The self follows every whim; the whisper of Shaytan is louder than the whisper of faith.

rows.Name: Lawwamah
rows.Description: The believer's normal state. The self commits sin, then immediately feels guilt. The conscience is active and loud.

rows.Name: Mulhamah
rows.Description: The soul that has been inspired to distinguish good from evil. It receives ilham from Allah. It is rare and precious.

rows.Name: Mutmainnah
rows.Description: The highest station attainable in this life. The soul is at peace with Allah, with His decree, and with His creation.
